title: File:Soprum.jpg
author: Alicia Fagerving
notes: Licence CC BY-SA 3.0 per the Commons file metadata (LicenseShortName), own work. No people. Chosen for the apartment common-areas idea: the shared bin room of a student apartment house in Gothenburg, with the paper container heaped over the rim and cardboard and a rubbish bag left on the floor. Large instruction sign, recycling posters, bin labels and a supermarket bag blurred; a thin strip on the left cropped to remove a partial poster word.

title: File:ADRI self-service car wash in Jelgava.jpg
author: Андрей Романенко
notes: Licence CC BY-SA 4.0 per the Commons file metadata (LicenseShortName), own work. Only the arm of the person washing the dark car is visible, nobody identifiable. Chosen for the self-service idea: modern jet-wash bays (ADRI, Jelgava, Latvia) with a silver car standing parked in one bay. Operator name on the canopy cropped out; bay signs, instruction boards, equipment brand plates, both licence plates and the car badges blurred.

title: File:Galley 2 Harmony of the Seas 2026.jpg
author: Larry D. Moore
notes: Licence CC BY 4.0 per the Commons file metadata (LicenseShortName), own work. Two cooks at the back, seen from behind; the profile of the far cook blurred. Original is 3001 px wide, so the full-size file was downloaded. Chosen for the restaurants and kitchens idea: a large stainless commercial galley (cruise ship Harmony of the Seas) with covered trays standing on the prep tables. Wine box label, cleaning bottle label, hand-washing sign and a paper notice blurred.

title: File:Млекарница „Осогово Милк“ 13.jpg
author: Македонец
notes: Licence CC BY-SA 4.0 per the Commons file metadata (LicenseShortName), own work. No people. Chosen for the production-line idea: a stainless rotary cup filling machine with an empty outfeed conveyor in the Osogovo Milk dairy, Sokolarci, North Macedonia. The original is slightly soft (handheld, low light); the best clean, people-free and brand-free dairy line found on Commons. Machine label and a conveyor sticker blurred.
